title: Verify Protocol Optimization Report against codebase and add Sprint-level development plan
body:
Scanned all 113 `.zod.ts` protocol files against the claims in `PROTOCOL_OPTIMIZATION_REPORT.md`. Found 3 P0 items already implemented, multiple incorrect file counts/paths, and re-prioritized the roadmap accordingly.

### Corrections

- **Cursor pagination**: Already in `query.zod.ts` (`cursor: z.record(...)`) — removed from backlog
- **Plugin registry**: `kernel/plugin-registry.zod.ts` fully implements discovery/validation/install — removed from backlog
- **Unified query DSL**: `data/query.zod.ts` provides base unified language — demoted to P1 (API adapter layer still needed)
- **File counts**: 113 files (not 127), `events.zod.ts` 766 lines in `kernel/` (not 772 in `system/`), `logging.zod.ts` 579 (not 682), `metrics.zod.ts` 597 (not 705), `agent.zod.ts` 80 (not 59)

### Confirmed issues

- UI layer has zero i18n integration (despite `system/translation.zod.ts` existing)
- `websocket.zod.ts` / `realtime.zod.ts` overlap on Presence and Subscription schemas
- GraphQL Federation: only a comment, no directive schemas
- Zero disaster recovery / failover schemas
- `cache.zod.ts` at 71 lines lacks distributed consistency

### Added verification assessment section

Top of document now includes a verification table mapping each original claim → actual codebase state, plus a reasonableness rating for each suggestion with priority adjustments.

### Added concrete development plan (10 Sprints, 3 Phases)

| Phase | Timeline | Sprints | Key deliverables |
|-------|----------|---------|-----------------|
| P0 | 2 weeks | 1-2 | UI i18n schema + realtime protocol dedup |
| P1 | 1-2 months | 3-6 | GraphQL Federation, multi-agent AI, driver refactor, API query adapters |
| P2 | 3-6 months | 7-10 | Disaster recovery, cache enhancement, external-lookup retry, events.zod.ts modularization |

Each sprint specifies files to create/modify, schema names, estimated effort, and deliverables.
